As a 45-year-old farmer in North West Nigeria with some schooling, I have learned that using a bit of fertilizer and improved seed helps my maize grow better, even on this small plot of 0.27 hectares. I will apply both chemical fertilizer and manure because the soil here needs nourishment, but I cannot afford too much. I will buy improved maize seed from the market because it gives better yield than our local variety, and I will spray herbicide to control weeds since I do not have enough family hands to weed the whole farm. I will rely on rainfall because I do not have access to irrigation, and my family will do most of the work, though I may hire a few extra hands during planting and harvest time.
